basic_info.description: Welcome to 2367 32nd Ave fully renovated Sunset home with nothing was spared, has it all; 3 bdrms, 4 baths, a fantastic floorplan, abundant natural light + custom made cabinets, professional grade Thermador appliances and oversize 9ft wide center island, 2 nice size beds -(master suite offer huge bath with custom made vanity, stand free tub + walk-in shower with direct balcony access) + full hall bath completes the main level with showcases an open plan kitchen/living room/large dining area with sleek lighting, glass paned stairways leads to lower level offers third master suite with full bath and another full bath, the tremendous size family/party room with custom made cabinets, wet bar, wine cooler and laundry are with extra storage space. Also leads to amazing, meticulous designed rear yard with IPE decking. Radiant heat throughout the house, top of line light fixtures, Brizo / Hansgrohe faucets and showers. Too Much To List, do not miss this must see house.
